hero.subtitle: When something feels wrong, but you can't put your finger on it.
hero.subtitle_validation: When you tell yourself: "Maybe I'm overreacting."
hero.subtitle_validation_response: That doubt doesn't make your experience any less real.
hero.p1: This is a place to come when something is wrong – at work, in studies, in relationships, in the family, or online. When you're not sure what's happening – or if you're even allowed to talk about it.
hero.p2: This is an empowerment tool for you. You get language for your experience, tools to make sense of your situation, and a way forward – step by step.
hero.quit_anytime: NOTHING IS SAVED WITHOUT YOUR CONSENT

dialog.title: How Safewing Works?
dialog.step1_text: Take assessments that help name mechanisms (gaslighting, exclusion, power abuse).
dialog.step2_text: Find language for what has so far been just a vague feeling of 'something wrong'.
dialog.step3_text: Use simulators to test reactions and documentation tools to collect facts.
dialog.step4_text: Coaching and tools help build a clear, safe path forward.

situations.label: Who is this for?
situations.title: Maybe you recognized yourself
situations.hint: Click a situation to see more.

comparison.title: Is this bullying?
comparison.col1_p1: Bullying is not always shouting. It is often silent: avoiding eye contact, withholding information, forgetting from meetings.
comparison.col1_p2: It is when you feel in your gut that something is wrong, but you are told 'you are just imagining'.
comparison.col2_p1: It's not always about one context. The same power dynamic repeats in workplaces, schools, relationships, and families.
comparison.col2_p2: If you are constantly on guard — whether it's work, school, or home — it is no longer about 'chemistry' or 'humor'.
comparison.quote: "It is not a fight if only one is being hit."

log.title: Private Log
log.subtitle: Write it down. Immediately.
log.box_text: When you are stressed, your memory fails. The bully relies on that. Do not give them that advantage.
log.importance_p1: Occupational safety, doctor, and union ask first: 'Do you have examples written down?'
log.importance_p2: When you have it in black and white, the conversation changes from 'word against word' to fact-based.
research: Documentation restores the sense of control.
Keeping a diary reduces stress symptoms.

privacy.local: We do not save your data to the cloud. Everything stays on your device.
privacy.pdf: You can download a PDF report anytime. This is your evidence.

power.title: You have the power
power.text: We do not decide for you. We do not urge you to resign, nor force you to fight.
power.quote: "Courage is not the absence of fear. Courage is acting despite fear."
power.text_bold: We give you a map and a compass. You choose the route.

quote.text: Bullying is not a conflict. It is a power imbalance that only one party has chosen.
quote.author: Safewing

footer_slogan.title: You are not obligated to know yet what this is.
footer_slogan.subtitle: It is enough that you notice it.
footer_slogan.disclaimer_2: NOTHING IS SAVED WITHOUT YOUR PERMISSION.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We look for answers so you don't have to.
faq.a1: No. All data is saved only in your browser's memory (Local Storage). We have no database, and we do not see what you write. If you clear browsing history, data disappears.
faq.q2: Can employer see that I use this?
faq.a2: No. The site works like any website. We recommend using private browsing (Incognito) and a personal device.
faq.a3: No. This is a peer support and informational tool. We do not offer legal services. In serious situations, contact a union or lawyer.
faq.q4: What if the bully is a supervisor?
faq.a4: This is common. Therefore documentation is especially important. The occupational safety organization is the right party to help then.
faq.q5: Can I use the report in court?
faq.a5: Yes. A diary produced by yourself is evidence. A PDF report is a clear way to present the course of events.
faq.a6: No. Safewing is a free tool.
faq.q9: Where can I get outside help?
faq.a9_text: We won't leave you alone. Here are official routes:
faq.a9_list_1: Occupational Safety: Regional State Administrative Agency (AVI)
